note: Frozen after development on 2020-2022 only (77 rule configurations tried, see totals.json dev). Evaluated ONCE on 2023-2025 by scripts/research/totals.py holdout. Bettable books = my_books.json allowed books present in the data; one bet per game at the first qualifying snapshot, best-scoring book/side there.
pass_bar: mean price-based CLV > 0 with one-sided p < 0.05/3 (t-test over bets); CLV = EV of (side, point, price) under the closing fair total (last pre-kickoff snapshot, ~75 min out; sharp books lowvig/betonlineag/circasports/bookmaker, else all books), key-number total distribution fit on 2012-2019.

rules.name: R1_soft_vs_sharp_early
rules.desc: At the Tuesday 14:10 UTC or Friday 21:40 UTC snapshot, bet any allowed-book over/under whose EV under the sharp books' no-vig fair total AT THAT SNAPSHOT exceeds +1%.

rules.name: R2_wind15_under_tuesday
rules.desc: Outdoor/open-roof game with RECORDED game wind >= 15 mph: bet the under at the Tuesday snapshot, best allowed price. OPTIMISTIC: recorded wind stands in for a 5-day forecast a Tuesday bettor would not have.

rules.name: R3_model_predicts_move
rules.desc: Predicted close = current fair total (sharp, else all) + beta * (walk-forward totals model - current fair); beta fit on 2020-2022 (Tue 0.105, Fri 0.051). Model = ridge on EWMA team EPA/success, neutral pace (sec/play), plays, points, indoor, division, league scoring level; trained only on prior seasons (2013+), no weather. Bet the over/under at an allowed book when EV under the predicted close > 0.
